title: Preparation of Exam Report Responses (Trademark Prosecution)
summary: A three-hour live training on examination report responses, worked on a real Registry examination report: reading the report, choosing the route for Section 9 and Section 11 objections, structuring the reply and assembling the evidence index, then drafting the response live on screen. Bring your own examination report and we will work through two or three.
format: Real Registry examination report + live drafting
certificate: Certificate of Training on successful completion
